name: deployment-triage
purpose: Guide an agent through recurring deployment triage after a failed health check.
activation: A deployment health check reports failed.
outcome: The observed failure boundary and next authorized investigation are reported.

steps: Report the boundary and supporting observation.
Invoke incident-investigation for the authorized investigation.
branches.completion: The boundary and investigation result are reported.

branches.predicate: The failing boundary is not localized
branches.completion: The missing evidence and smallest next check are reported.
